api.setMood: idle|attack|hurt|phase|death. phase tears the apron at 0.72 s and the phase 2 painting then stays
api.setPhase: rig.setPhase(2) switches to the phase 2 painting (0.4 s crossfade) without the tear
api.setBroken: rig.setBroken({'foreman-grate': true}) or rig.state.broken[id] = true; the page rebuilds both textures with a notch, ember rim and ink cracks
api.act: rig.act('foreman-rivet') fires the muzzle flash and arm kick

brokenFlag: foreman-apron shows only in phase 1, foreman-bulwark only in phase 2; the others in both
stage: stage aspect 1496 x 1612 (painting plus pad); anchors are image pixels, rig.anchor(id) returns CSS pixels
